lead.headline: In the new Mountain West, the road runs through the Pit
lead.deck: With five programs gone to the Pac-12, New Mexico is the best team in all four of our conferences. Nevada owns the league's best win. Grand Canyon is right there.
body: The Mountain West woke up this season with a different shape. Boise State, Colorado State, Fresno State, San Diego State and Utah State are gone to the Pac-12, and a ten-team league is working out who sets the standard now.

So far the answer is New Mexico. The Lobos are 3-0 and have won all three games at the Pit by at least 25. Our model has them 26th nationally, the highest rating of any of the 42 teams Hardwood Bricks covers. Their first road test comes Saturday night at Santa Clara, which the model calls an 83-82 coin flip.

The best single win belongs to Nevada, 96-95 over Saint Mary's at Lake Tahoe last weekend. Three nights later the Wolf Pack lost 76-63 at UC Santa Barbara. That's November in one week. The model still has Nevada 68th, a whisker behind Grand Canyon (67th). The Lopes are 3-0 and have scored 99 in two straight games.

Then come the surprises. Air Force has scored 107 points twice in a week, which is not a sentence anyone expected to type about Air Force. Hawai'i is 3-1 after a home loss to Portland. Wyoming lost by 13 at North Carolina, which is about what the market expected.

Two marquee nights are coming. Stanford visits UNLV on Friday on CBS Sports Network, a game the model calls dead even at 78. Then UNLV goes to Kansas on Tuesday on ESPN, the league's biggest stage of the month.

column.label: Look Ahead
column.title: Picks for a big Mountain West weekend
body: The new Mountain West has something to prove, and this week it gets two national TV windows to prove it. Here's how I see it shaking out.

**UNLV 79, Stanford 76.** The model calls it a dead heat. I'm calling the Thomas & Mack. A Friday night crowd on CBS Sports Network, with a power-conference team in the building? The Rebels don't let this one go.
**New Mexico 84, Santa Clara 80.** First road game for the best team in the league, in a building that is never easy. The Lobos win anyway, because that's what the good ones do.
**Grand Canyon 95, UL Monroe 70.** The Lopes have scored 99 twice in a row. Let's say they get to 95 and the student section gets loud about it.
**Wyoming 75, Denver 72.** A mile-high matchup at the Hamilton Gym. Wyoming knows altitude better than anybody.
**Kansas 85, UNLV 70 on Tuesday.** Some nights the jerseys win. Allen Fieldhouse is one of them. Play well and keep it under 15, and the trip still counts.
Upset special: Air Force wins at Pacific. The Falcons have scored 107 twice. I've stopped asking questions.

notes.headline: Air Force, at 107
notes.body: The Falcons beat Calumet St. Joseph 107-58 and Loyola Chicago 107-93. Against Loyola they were 12.5-point favorites and won by 14. The model still rates them 296th, so enjoy it while it lasts.

notes.headline: Nevada at Tahoe
notes.body: The 96-95 win over Saint Mary's at the Tahoe Blue Event Center is the best neutral-site win by any team in our four conferences this season. The Wolf Pack host Utah Valley on Saturday.

notes.headline: Hawai'i drops one at home
notes.body: Portland won 73-66 at the Stan Sheriff Center. The Rainbow Warriors host Washington State on Wednesday night, which the model has as a three-point game.

notes.headline: Circle it
notes.body: Stanford at UNLV, Friday, 9 p.m., CBS Sports Network. The model has it 78-78. You won't find a closer number this week.
